newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks little changed in London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks little changed in London.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were holding near Hong Kong closing levels in lacklustre trading, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was off 19.02 points at 12,918.46 at 1417 GMT, reflecting a small decline in shares in HSBC Holdings from their closing levels in Hong Kong, they said.
HSBC was trading at 156.125 in London, compared with a close of 156.500 in Hong Kong. Dealers attributed the drop to currency-related pressure. But turnover, they added, was very low.
The benchmark Hang Seng Index closed 153.41 points higher at 12,937.48 in Hong Kong.
